path.description: Use in path= and in downloads

used.description: Bytes of the blocks that held data

image_partitions.description: Image jobs: only these partitions (none = the whole disk)

kind.description: Jobs for VMs, databases, NAS shares and Microsoft 365 are created in the console

source_job_id.description: Copy jobs: the job whose backups are copied

window.description: Backup window: runs start only between window_from and window_to

kind.description: e.g. EFI System, Basic data, Recovery

number.description: Number to select in an image job

used.description: Bytes in use at the newest successful image backup of the partition (absent without one)

used_at.description: When used was measured (end of that backup)

RestoreRequest.description: Give either target or original: true.

agent_id.description: Agent that writes the files; default: the agent that was backed up

paths.description: Files and folders to restore, as backed up; empty = everything

target.description: Folder on the agent to restore into

verify.description: Compare every restored file with the backup

Retention.description: Snapshots to keep; a missing field is 0

commands.description: Commands before and after the backup with their output

image_disks.description: Disk image backups: the disks in the backup

kind.description: backup, restore, image-backup, vm-backup, verify (restore test), copy, sql-backup …

snapshot.description: ID of the backup a backup run made

stats.description: Backups: files, bytes (size of the source), bytes_read, bytes_added, bytes_stored (uploaded) …

suspicious.description: Why the backup looks like ransomware or mass deletion

Schedule.description: When a job runs. Fields not used by the kind are ignored.

after_any.description: chain: also when that job failed

after_job.description: chain: the job this one follows

days.description: daily, interval and since_last: weekdays, 0 = Sunday; empty = every day

every_hours.description: since_last: hours after the previous scheduled run (1-8760); days limits it to weekdays

every_minutes.description: interval: a divisor of 60 below an hour (5, 10, 15, 20, 30), or whole hours that divide 24 (60, 120, 180, 240, 360, 480, 720, 1440)

from_time.description: interval: window start HH:MM; runs start at from_time and then every every_minutes. Replaces from_hour/to_hour

months.description: daily, interval, monthly, since_last: only in these months (1-12); empty = every month

ok.description: No failures in 24 h, nothing suspicious unreviewed, every agent online

recovery_key.description: Own recovery key (32 letters and digits in groups of four); generated when empty

recovery_key_from.description: ID of an encrypted target whose recovery key the new target uses (one key for e.g. a NAS and the cloud copy); the key is then not returned

s3_lock_days.description: Immutable for this many days with S3 Object Lock (the bucket needs Object Lock); 0 = off

url.description: local: folder on the agent; sftp: sftp://user@host:22/path

recovery_key.description: Only for encrypted targets, only in this response: keep it safe, without it the backups cannot be read if the console is lost

recovery_key_from.description: Set when the target uses the recovery key of that target

test.description: Connection test (not for local and USB targets); a failed test leaves the target in place

info.description: REST API of the BackupZit console. Create a token under My account → API tokens and send it as `Authorization: Bearer bzt_…`. The token's role decides what it may do (viewer < restore operator < operator < administrator). Every action done with a token is in the audit log. Five requests with an invalid token block the address for a while (HTTP 429). The console serves this file at /api/v1/openapi.json; `info.x-backupzit-version` is the console's version.
info.title: BackupZit REST API

post.description: Role: backup operator (commands: administrator). Files, disk image (Windows: whole disk, all disks or some partitions), Linux system or copy jobs, checked like in the console.

delete.description: Role: backup operator. Existing backups remain on the storage. With four-eyes approval on, jobs are deleted in the console (409).

patch.description: Role: backup operator (commands: administrator). With four-eyes approval on, a shorter retention is changed in the console (409). Jobs that are part of a job for several agents are changed in the console (409).

get.description: Role: restore operator. {id} is a file or Linux system backup on network storage; the console reads it from the storage. Disk image backups: the first level lists the NTFS volumes ("C" for C:\), below it their files.

parameters.description: Folder inside the backup (a path from a previous listing); empty = the top
parameters.name: path

get.summary: Agent log file sent by an agent-log run

post.description: Role: restore operator. {id} is a successful backup run (files, Linux system, Microsoft 365, a copy of file backups, or a disk image). An agent writes the files into a folder or back to where they were backed up from. For a disk image, paths are required and given as GET /api/v1/runs/{id}/files lists them (the first folder is the volume); one restore run per volume is queued and listed in run_ids. Whole disks: POST /api/v1/runs/{id}/restore-disk. VMs and databases are restored in the console.

Role: restore operator. {id} is a successful disk image backup (Windows) or Linux system backup. Overwrites a whole disk of an agent, also one started from the recovery media. A machine with several disks is restored one disk per call.
post.summary: Restore a disk image or Linux system onto a disk
